name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. Domain chapter_15 is a meaningful chapter ID (range 01-30); the 15 is the in-game chapter number, NOT a Ghidra address remnant (the function is at 0x20822 and dispatched from handler-table index 14). Descriptor post_action correctly reflects that this is the chapter-15 turn-cycle post-action handler dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_post_action_handler_table[14].
purpose: Chapter 15 turn-cycle post-action handler: runs the default win/lose check, then adds a single-slot lose-condition override (key NPC at runtime_char[0x40] dead -> game over).
logic_summary: Calls fd2_check_battle_end_condition() (the default win/lose evaluation), then queries fd2_check_char_is_dead(0x40); if that key NPC slot is dead it sets data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (0x53ECC) to 1 (game over). event_arg is the dispatch/__CHK-prologue artifact and is unused by the body.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: cdecl arg pushed by the dispatch site (active char_idx) per the handler-table calling convention; unused by the body (Watcom __CHK-prologue artifact).
params.reason: Descriptive, no address taint. Acceptable name for the unused dispatch-convention parameter; matches the naming used across all sibling post-action handlers in this file.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the conditional write to data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code.

notes: Verified: xref to 0x20822 is the single DATA ref at 0x51B51, which holds bytes 22 08 02 00 = 0x20822; offset from table base 0x51B19 is 0x38 = 14 entries, confirming handler-table index 14 (= chapter 15). Source comment (chpost.c lines 154-176) already precise and matches decompilation, so no Edit was made. Ghidra plate is terser but consistent (no contradiction) -> left unchanged. fd2-knowledge confirms chapter 15 = 拉卡湖的激戰. globals.h confirms data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code @ 0x53ECC; protos.h confirms fd2_check_char_is_dead(uint32) and fd2_check_battle_end_condition(void). reads_globals empty because the runtime_char read is delegated to the fd2_check_char_is_dead callee, not done inline.
